figurative_meaning_en: Mutual exchange of knowledge or secrets between each other
similar_in_english: You tell me yours and I'll tell you mine
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই বন্ধু জানাজানি করে সময় কাটাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The two friends spent time in mutual gossiping.
note: This is a sahachara shabda (companion word) indicating reciprocal sharing, common in Bengali colloquial speech.
